    The initial walk of Fischbacher's Lemma 5.2 #

    Walking along w from a point below e to b (which is not below e) finds an arrow α of w from a point below e to a point not below e (find_end). If e is not on w, the segment (path to e, α) starts a good walk (exists_init_walk), and e and the target of α are incomparable by Lemma 4.2 (incomp_end).

    The initial walk of Fischbacher's proof of Lemma 5.2.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.lemma52_of_step {A : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} A] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms A] [IsRayCategory A] (hcf : ∀ (x : A) (p : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk x) (RayVert.mk x)), p.length = 0) (hint : ∀ (a b : A), (interval a b).Finite) (hsc : ∀ (D : Set A), D.Finite → ConvexR D → ∀ (c : ArrowWeight A), (IsCocycleOn D fun {x y : RayVert A} => c) → IsCoboundaryOn D fun {x y : RayVert A} => c) {b : A} (hstep : ∀ {a₀ : A} (w : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk a₀) (RayVert.mk b)) (z : ZWalk b), z.Good w → (∃ σ ∈ z.segs, pathVal σ.t = 0) → ∃ (z' : ZWalk b), z'.d₀ = z.d₀ ∧ z'.Good w ∧ z'.hull ⊂ z.hull) {a : A} (v w : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk a) (RayVert.mk b)) {d : A} (hd : d ∈ pathVerts v) :
    ChainFromTo d (pathVerts w)

    Fischbacher's Lemma 5.2, assuming the hull-shrinking step of §5.3–5.4: a good walk with a zero t-path can be replaced by a good walk with the same first peak and a strictly smaller hull. Then every point d on a path v parallel to w is joined by a chain to a point of w.
